name: Blackmail and Education
source:
There's always something going on at St. Henny's High School. With so many naughty troublemakers around, things are bound to get out of hand! That's exactly why a group of horny girls get into a spot of bother, but receive a most challenging homework assignment as 'punishment' - they must explore their darkest sexual urges!
Enjoy the adventures of Effy, Rachel, Holly, Naomi, and others to see what kind of trouble the girls can get into.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
圣亨尼高中总是有活动发生。这么多顽皮的捣蛋鬼，事情肯定会失控的！这正是为什么一群饥渴的女孩陷入困境，却收到最具挑战性的家庭作业作为“惩罚”——她们必须探索自己最黑暗的性冲动！
享受艾菲、瑞秋、霍莉、内奥米等人的冒险，看看女孩们会遇到什么样的麻烦。

[来自F95Zone]
